objective: Test one bounded change: a target-free learned user-level gate that selectively applies the frozen GACR-v3 residual to reduce Toys tail and Recall@50 harm while preserving cross-domain NDCG growth.

single_changed_factor.name: target_free_learned_residual_application_gate
single_changed_factor.definition: A seed-specific logistic gate uses eight target-free aggregates of the frozen candidate/base/residual tensors and either applies the full frozen v3 residual or returns the exact GRAM ranking.
single_changed_factor.training_label: On fit users only, rank improvement versus rank harm among union-covered examples whose frozen-v3 rank differs from GRAM.
single_changed_factor.selection_scope: One threshold per development domain, shared across the three frozen residual seeds.
single_changed_factor.identity_control: Threshold 0 applies the residual to every user and exactly reproduces GACR-v3.
single_changed_factor.frozen_components: GRAM checkpoints, GACR-v3 residual states, candidate construction, six residual features, fit/calibration user split, residual architecture and all residual parameters.

threshold_selection.eligible: In every seed calibration cell: overall Recall@10 nondecrease, overall Recall@50 nondecrease, tail NDCG@10 nondecrease, tail Recall@50 nondecrease, and broad harm <=1%.
threshold_selection.objective: Maximum mean overall NDCG@10 within each development domain.
threshold_selection.tie_break: Higher mean tail NDCG@10, lower maximum broad harm, then lower threshold.
threshold_selection.fail_closed: Threshold 0 is the exact frozen GACR-v3 identity control.

development_reporting: GRAM baseline, frozen GACR-v3, and GACR-v4
three-seed stability and incremental delta versus v3

decision_rule.keep_v4: V4 mean NDCG@10 is strictly above v3 in Toys and in the two-domain macro average; Beauty mean NDCG@10 is not below v3; Toys mean tail NDCG@10 and Recall@50 are not below v3; all integrity and safety cells pass.
decision_rule.return_to_v3: Otherwise retain frozen GACR-v3 and stop this gate configuration without closing the GACR direction.

post_run_policy: Write results only. Do not analyze, retry, read Sports/test, or start another experiment until explicitly requested by the researcher.
